children: shares fell on Friday following a five-day winning streak as CFRA downgraded the life sciences company to Hold from Buy, citing a less attractive upside opportunity in the near term after its recent rally.
“Though we think RVTY’s fundamental story remains compelling, we think near-term upside is less attractive following recent valuation expansion,” analyst Daniel Rich wrote, according to Bloomberg.

The Waltham, Massachusetts-based company, formerly known as PerkinElmer, has added nearly 50% in value this year, with the stock trading near a post-pandemic high. The downgrade came after its shares set a new 52-week high earlier this week after the company presented at Baird’s 2026 Global

“We look to 3Q results to help confirm indications of instrument backlog conversion and software sales momentum, which we think could lead to stronger earnings guidance that helps normalize RVTY’s valuation," Rich added as he boosted his price target to $157 from $145 per share.

title: Revvity slips as CFRA downgrades on limited near-term upside
